patthana24.21:1.1: na saraṇaṃ na sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. ekaṃ.
patthana24.21:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. nasaraṇaduka nacittaduke saraṇaduka cittadukaṃ
patthana24.21:3.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. saṅkhittaṃ. nasaraṇaduka nacetasikaduke saraṇaduka cetasikadukaṃ
patthana24.21:4.1: na saraṇaṃ na cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. nasaraṇaduka nacittasampayuttaduke saraṇaduka cittasampayuttadukaṃ
patthana24.21:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. dve. nasaraṇaduka nacittasaṃsaṭṭhaduke saraṇaduka cittasaṃsaṭṭhadukaṃ
patthana24.21:6.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo cittasaṃsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. pe. nasaraṇaduka nadassanenapahātabbaduke saraṇaduka dassanenapahātabbadukaṃ
